description: MUTATES one owned Dayze contact by person_id. A context_tags-only patch is supported; send the full desired tag array (a repeat is a no-op). last_interaction_at corrects when the user was last in touch (owner-set). For personal-write OAuth send request_id, a unique string for each new write; reuse it for an exact retry. Fields left out are untouched. undo_contact_change(change_id) reverts a change. Requires context.write; share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

address.description: Postal address (one line). Null or blank clears

birthday.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or MM-DD / --MM-DD (year unknown; 02-29 ok). Null/empty clears

cadence_days.description: Check-in every N days; null or 0 turns check-ins off. Next check-in is recomputed

context_tags.description: Contexts such as Work, Personal, Family, plus custom tags

death_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; marks the contact deceased. Null clears

expected_updated_at.description: Optional. The updated_at you last read for this record (ISO timestamp). The write applies only if the record has not changed since; otherwise it returns code "conflict" with the current record and changes nothing.

first_met.description: When/how they first met (free text). Null or blank clears

first_met_location.description: Where they first met. Null or blank clears

is_deceased.description: false also clears death_date and the memorial reminder

is_favorite.description: Favorite flag. Favorites (and VIP) appear in get_context_pack inner_circle

last_interaction_at.description: Owner's correction of when they were last in touch (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO date-time with zone; not future). Saved as owner-set and kept in the contact's history; newer activity still moves it forward.

name.description: Rename contact (also refreshes URL slug). Prefer this over create+merge for spelling fixes

notes.description: Replaces people.notes (does not append). Empty or null clears

person_id.description: UUID of a person the authenticated user owns

preserve_old_name_as_alias.description: When renaming, keep the previous name as a former_name alias (default true)

pronouns.description: e.g. she/her. Null or blank clears

relationship.description: Relationship label (friend, sister, …). Empty or null clears

relationships.description: Who they are to the user, in primary-first order (for example Friend + Client)

request_id.description: Required on personal-write OAuth. Unique for a new write; reuse for an exact retry.

tier.description: Relationship priority. VIP stays in inner_circle even when not favorited

wallets.description: PHI-930: full list of ENS (.eth) / SNS (.sol) names and/or addresses for this contact. Merged into social_handles (legacy ens/ens_address kept); empty array clears wallet keys only.

name: update_person

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

change_id.description: Pass to undo_contact_change to revert this change, birthday and birthday_precision included.

changed.description: Changed fields with before and after values.

former_name_alias.description: After a rename that keeps the old name (preserve_old_name_as_alias, default true): alias, saved, and reason when it could not be kept.

hint.description: Where the not_applied fields are changed instead (the Dayze profile).

is_self.description: True when the person is the user's own card (Me).

items.description: On Me, a profile-mirrored field (name, birthday) that was not saved.

person.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.

source.description: chatgpt for ChatGPT OAuth writes; mcp for another OAuth app or API key.
